name: rahigh-khabar-backend
description: Rahigh Khabar backend: manual news, image uploads and site SEO

scripts.dev: npm run prisma:generate && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.test: npm run prisma:generate && node --import tsx --import ./tests/setup.ts --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:news: npm run prisma:generate && node --import tsx --import ./tests/setup.ts --test tests/news-*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run prisma:generate && node --import tsx --import ./tests/setup.ts --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:media-seo: npm run prisma:generate && node --import tsx --import ./tests/setup.ts --test tests/media-*.test.ts tests/seo-*.test.ts
